name: Share sheet
oneLiner: a glass share sheet rises over a dimmed page in slow 3D, the app tiles pop in, a fingertip glides to the brand's app and taps it, the tile squashes and springs with a ripple, a green check lands on its corner and a Shared pill drops in under the sheet
say: when the speaker says 'people started sharing it' or 'send it to a friend': the tap lands on 'share' or 'send', the Shared pill on the payoff
